trips.route_note: Take a train or long-distance bus from Beijing to Chengde, about 2.5 to 3 hours, then a taxi or local bus to the Mountain Resort.
trips.tour_query: Chengde Mountain Resort day trip from Beijing
trips.why: The train takes about 2h 8m to Chengde South, which is faster and more direct than the roughly 4-hour bus, and a taxi or local bus covers the last stretch to the sights.
know: The Mountain Resort is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is the main reason to visit.
Plan for a full day because the round trip is long and the resort is large.

trips.route_note: Take a high-speed train from Beijing South or Beijing station to Tianjin station, about 30 minutes; the Tianjin Metro or a taxi reaches the historic district.
trips.why: The high-speed train from Beijing South to Tianjin Station takes about 30 minutes, so it is much faster than driving or a taxi.
know: Trains run from Beijing South or Beijing station to Tianjin Station.
A taxi or the Tianjin Metro is needed to reach the historic district from the station.
